what: A replay script that autonomously drives two DS instances from the Cantina lobby save state into a Bounty Hunter match on Jabba's Tower with Boba Fett and Greedo.
source_capture: out/work/gpudump_menu_demo/input.csv - a demonstration recorded with per-instance touch, the first capture in which stylus input is correctly attributed.

verified.arena: JABBA'S TOWER found in main RAM at frame 6300 (demo 6350)
verified.method: Arena model bytes located in main RAM; character indices read from actor +0x6BB on PLAYER_TICK.

why_the_repeated_tap: The demonstration has player 2 tapping the browse list at frames 4185 and 4208 while player 1 does not begin hosting until 4467. A human taps the host entry the moment it appears; absolute frame numbers cannot, because it appears at a different time every run. Player 2's browse tap at (53,49) is therefore repeated every 40 frames, 6 frames on, across the window in which the host can appear. A tap on an empty list does nothing.
why_to_frame_5200: The first attempt repeated the tap to frame 5780 and produced Boba Fett against LANDO (34) instead of Greedo: the join had already succeeded and the surplus taps were landing on the character-select screen, walking player 2's cursor off Greedo. Stopping at 5200 keeps the join reliable and leaves the selection alone. This is the one tuned number in the script - if the join starts failing, widen it; if player 2's character drifts, narrow it.
do_not_use: The original out/work/gpudump_abilities/input.csv cannot drive the menus. It was recorded before touch was per-instance, so both DSes logged each other's taps, and replaying it hosts a single-card game.
